Description.description: Routing table that maps an InsightSummaryCard topic+mode (e.g., matter-health/single) to its JPS playbook + display configuration. Required for the sparkle icon to render on a host record (spec FR-05 — no orphan sparkles). SME-editable via Power Apps model-driven app form (spec FR-09).

Server-side cache TTL applied to invocations for this topic (spec FR-21). Read by the BFF cache layer; overrides the r2 universal 15-minute IInsightsPlaybookExecutionCache default. Bound 1..1440 (1 minute to 24 hours). Default for matter-health is 60 (1 hour).
Human-facing card title rendered as the InsightSummaryCard header. Example: 'Matter Health Insights'.

Soft on/off toggle. When false, the sparkle icon does NOT render on host records for this topic+mode, even if other fields are valid. Distinct from statecode (Dataverse soft-delete / lifecycle state). Allows SMEs to disable a topic in production without record deletion.

Soft on/off toggle. When false, the sparkle icon does NOT render on host records for this topic+mode, even if other fields are valid. Distinct from statecode (Dataverse soft-delete / lifecycle state). Allows SMEs to disable a topic in production without record deletion.

Dataverse logical name of the host record type. Example: sprk_matter. Used by the InsightSummaryCard mount-time check: card renders the sparkle only when host entity + topic + mode triple is registered (spec FR-05).

Fluent UI v9 icon component name as string (project Q-U2 — mirrors sprk_gridconfiguration.sprk_iconname). Examples: Sparkle24Filled, Bot24Regular, Lightbulb24Filled. Resolved client-side via @fluentui/react-icons lookup; empty/unresolved -> fallback to Sparkle24Filled.
Analysis mode discriminator. r1 ships 'single' only; framework-shaped for 'portfolio' and 'comparative' per spec Out of Scope. Lowercase ASCII letters only.
Primary name. Convention: {sprk_topicname}/{sprk_mode} (e.g., matter-health/single). Synthesized by the model-driven app form OnSave handler at insert time; not user-editable post-create.

Foreign key by name (not lookup) to sprk_playbook.sprk_name. Example: matter-health-single. Must match an existing playbook row name exactly (case-insensitive). Versioning lives in sprk_playbook.sprk_version — MUST NOT contain @v1 or @vN suffix in this field (project Q-U1 ban).

Logical name of the single longtext field on the host entity where the playbook's JSON envelope is persisted. Example: sprk_performancesummary. Read by the UpdateRecord node in the playbook (spec FR-14).
Stable topic identifier (kebab-case). Example: matter-health. Lowercase ASCII letters / digits / hyphens only. Combined with sprk_mode is unique (alternate key sprk_AlternateKey_TopicMode).
